macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks extend rout as AI concerns deepen
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell 3.59% to 6,918.45, the Nasdaq Composite dropped 5.13% to 22,654.15, and the Dow declined 1.85% to 48,188.18. The selloff followed concerns that Anthropic’s market debut failed to revive enthusiasm for the AI trade, pushing the S&P 500 and Dow into correction territory.[1]

items.title: Fed governor argues rates may need to rise further
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said the current policy rate is not high enough to address inflation, strengthening the hawkish policy backdrop. The comments came as the dollar’s recent rally lost momentum amid broader risk aversion.[7]

items.title: AI trade weakness drives broader market correction
items.summary: Investor concerns about elevated AI valuations and technology-sector exposure intensified the week’s selloff. One market recap reported an 8.6% weekly decline for the S&P 500 and a 10% drop for the Nasdaq 100, alongside worries about rising interest rates.[2]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $61,000 after sharp sell-off
items.summary: Bitcoin rose 5.29% over 24 hours to about $61,081, following a recent plunge below $60,000. Solana also climbed 4.25% to roughly $70.

items.title: U.S. derivatives regulator outlines path for decentralized platforms
items.summary: CFTC Chairman Michael Selig discussed potential routes for decentralized derivatives platforms such as Hyperliquid to operate within the U.S. regulatory framework.

items.title: DTCC working group advances tokenized securities infrastructure
items.summary: Ondo Finance said it joined a Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation-led industry working group focused on designing a tokenization service for U.S. capital markets.

items.title: Figure launches yield-bearing stablecoin on Stellar
items.summary: Figure’s YLDS, described as a regulated, yield-bearing, dollar-pegged stable asset, launched on the Stellar network.

items.title: Cysic bridge exploit reportedly mints 10 million tokens
items.summary: An exploit involving the Cysic bridge reportedly created 10 million tokens on BNB Chain, adding to recent concerns over cross-chain security.

items.title: NEAR rises after governance reduces inflation
items.summary: NEAR Protocol gained 7.4% in 24 hours to about $2.92 after governance changes cut its inflation rate to 1.6%.

items.title: Japan tax investigation finds $24.5 million in undisclosed crypto income
items.summary: Japan’s Tokyo National Tax Agency reportedly identified about 3.9 billion yen in undeclared cryptocurrency-related income among 91 users and assessed roughly 1.2 billion yen in additional taxes.

items.title: Pump.fun to end external wallet logins
items.summary: Pump.fun announced that its web interface would stop supporting external wallet logins on November 22, marking a notable change to access for users of the Solana-based platform.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: GTA VI earns $3.79 billion in first 24 hours
items.summary: Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto VI reportedly generated $3.79 billion in first-day sales, setting a record for the biggest entertainment launch. The game also sold 32.5 million units before release, according to reports citing Rockstar.

items.title: Unreal Engine 6 to launch without Blueprints
items.summary: Epic reportedly plans to omit its long-standing Blueprints visual scripting system from Unreal Engine 6, including early access, as the company shifts toward AI-assisted coding.

items.title: Nicalis removes allegedly AI-generated music from Repentance+
items.summary: Nicalis removed music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players alleged that it was AI-generated and criticized the lack of disclosure. The change followed backlash and review-bombing on Steam.

items.title: Ubisoft reportedly forms generative-AI studio amid job cuts
items.summary: Ubisoft is reportedly creating a subsidiary called Motherbrain focused on generative AI in games while cutting 116 jobs across two studios, according to reporting summarized by Day One Daily.

items.title: Riot reveals League of Legends refresh called New Dawn
items.summary: Riot Games reportedly unveiled New Dawn at the League of Legends World Finals, showing a redesigned champion-select screen and refreshed map. No release date or pricing details were announced.

items.title: The Finals Grand Major 2026 announced for Stockholm
items.summary: The Finals Grand Major 2026 is scheduled to begin November 27 in Stockholm, with Twitch-drop cosmetics and prediction contests planned for viewers.

items.title: Studio Bravada announces closure
items.summary: Studio Bravada is reportedly shutting down after its second game, Extremely Powerful Capybaras, failed to recover development costs over three years.

items.title: Console shipments reportedly fell 36.5% in Q3
items.summary: S&P Global Market Intelligence Kagan data reportedly showed global console shipments falling 36.5% year over year to 6.4 million units in the third quarter.
